notes.title: UPDATE - Now Live!
notes.content:
*[b][u]Combat System[/u][/b]
We've improved the combat-system by considering your feedback. 
-Block behavior
-Enemy parameters
-Attack/block paramaters
-Attacking camera effects


*[b][u]Text-to-Speech[/u][/b]
Due to huge-hate on text-to-speech dialogues, they've all been muted. 
(If there is anyone still wants to have this feature, there is an extra setting on the options menu-audio and language)
Unfortunately, we can't afford voice acting at the moment. Therefore, we are sorry for not giving you better news.


*[b][u]Localization[/u][/b]
-Turkish language is added.
